cohort: The study included all women diagnosed with placenta previa managed at the Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology, Mysore Medical College & Research Institute, Mysore, over a 5-year period.
finding: Placenta previa is a major obstetric condition leading to adverse maternal outcomes such as postpartum hemorrhage and hysterectomy, and poor perinatal outcomes including high rates of preterm birth and mortality.
